message.mobilecellnetwork.technician.den: You cannot work on equipment here.
message.mobilecellnetwork.technician.own: Only the equipment owner or an operator can work on this installation.
message.mobilecellnetwork.technician.tar: Use this on an antenna or signal booster.
message.mobilecellnetwork.technician.cli: Climb to an upper platform, open its blue-label radio cabinet, and install the module inside.
message.mobilecellnetwork.technician.aim: Aim at an equipment cabinet: yellow power cabinet at the base, blue radio cabinets on the platforms.
message.mobilecellnetwork.technician.ope: Open this cabinet first: right-click it with an empty hand.
message.mobilecellnetwork.technician.use: Right-click a computer screen above an equipment cabinet to open tower controls.
message.mobilecellnetwork.technician.pow: Power cabinet open. Use the Cable Spool on its terminals to connect power, or the Technician Tester to commission.
message.mobilecellnetwork.technician.rad: Radio cabinet open. Use a Radio Electronics Module inside, then use the Technician Tester after wiring power.
message.mobilecellnetwork.technician.mod: Electronics installed. Connect power, then use a technician tester.
message.mobilecellnetwork.technician.bas: Connect the power wire inside the open yellow-label cabinet at the tower base.
message.mobilecellnetwork.technician.no_: There is no power wire to remove.
message.mobilecellnetwork.technician.dis: Power wire removed. Cable is not refunded; antennas and boosters need commissioning again after rewiring.
message.mobilecellnetwork.technician.wir: A wire is already connected. Sneak-use the spool here to remove it first.
message.mobilecellnetwork.technician.sel: Use the spool on an FE generator or battery output, then on the equipment base.
message.mobilecellnetwork.technician.dim: The selected power source is in another dimension. Selection cleared.
message.mobilecellnetwork.technician.unl: The selected source is not loaded. Move closer or select another source.
message.mobilecellnetwork.technician.len: The complete cable route must be at most %s blocks long and connect different blocks.
message.mobilecellnetwork.technician.sou: Select an extractable FE output face on a generator or battery, not another antenna or booster.
message.mobilecellnetwork.technician.spo: This wire needs %s cable units. Use a fuller spool.
message.mobilecellnetwork.technician.con: Power wire connected (%s cable units). Supply FE, then use the tester to commission.
message.mobilecellnetwork.technician.mon: Combined power/radio cabinet open. Install the radio module, connect power, then commission with the tester.
message.mobilecellnetwork.technician.cha: Charger cable connected (%s cable units). Supply FE to charge a phone; no radio module or commissioning is needed.
message.mobilecellnetwork.technician.sou: Cable attached. Click solid faces to add snaps, or connect straight to the equipment. Sneak-use in air cancels.
message.mobilecellnetwork.technician.sna: Cable snap %s attached. Continue routing or click the equipment to finish.
